update_interval_help: A check always runs at startup. This interval controls additional checks while running; a month is 30 days.
update_url: GitHub JSON address for version checking (optional)
source_url: GitHub base address for language packs (optional)
no_source: Please enter the GitHub address first.
repository_placeholder: Please replace xxxx in the GitHub address with the repository name.
network_error: The GitHub request failed. Please check the address and internet connection.
pack_error: The language pack is invalid, incomplete, intended for a different application, or already installed. Existing languages are preserved.
write_error: The settings could not be saved.
new_version: New version available: {version}. Nothing is installed automatically.
installed: Language and help installed. Save settings to apply.
help_error: Local help could not be opened.
license_notice: This application comes WITHOUT ANY WARRANTY.
profile_name_error: Please enter a unique profile name with 1 to 100 characters.
profiles_error: The profiles could not be loaded. The existing file is preserved.
file_dialog_error: The initial folder could not be opened.
protected_target: This file belongs to the application data and cannot be overwritten by an export. Please choose another location.
job_error: The operation failed. Further information is in the log.
waiting_close: The running operation is finishing. The application will then close.
demo_file_text: Test file from the Python base template.
log_readonly: The log is read-only. Export saves a separate copy.
log_error: The log could not be read.
cannot_cancel: This operation cannot be safely cancelled.
export_empty: There are no results to export.
software_unconfigured: Update checking is not configured yet
software_check_failed: Software status could not be checked
update_error: Version checking failed. The software status is unknown.
update_download_error: The update could not be downloaded and verified completely. Existing files are retained.
limits: Normal queries are unprivileged; extended RAM query only with the separate admin launcher. Missing detection does not establish an empty socket. Device polling: every 3 seconds.
export_note: Export the complete inventory. Personal data is excluded unless explicitly selected.
export_personal: Include personal data (MAC/IP/SSID, Bluetooth names, audio descriptions)
events_none: No changes detected. Monitoring starts at the first successful query; brief changes and query gaps may be missed.
ram_suspect: Discarded implausible lshw source value; not used as a speed
ram_unverified: Unverified lshw clock; not a verified data rate
component: Detected component; no socket occupancy assertion
drive: Drive; no assertion about free connectors
link_detected: Kernel reports a link; reachability of the other endpoint was not checked
no_carrier: No carrier signal reported; the cause is not determined
link_dormant: Interface is waiting for activation according to the kernel
lower_layer_down: Kernel reports an underlying link as down
interface_down: Kernel reports the interface as down
device_not_present: Kernel reports the device as not present
interface_up_link_unconfirmed: Interface is up; physical link is not confirmed
state_unconfirmed: Kernel state is inconclusive; reachability is not established
details_verified: Occupancy checked before opening. Values are from the inventory shown below.
details_removed: No longer current: device removed, disconnected or replaced. Further detail queries have stopped.
details_unverified: No longer current: occupancy cannot be verified again. Further detail queries have stopped. Please refresh inventory.
edid_modes_partial: Base EDID timings, incomplete mode list; verified XRandR mode list unavailable
ram_capture_ok: Last successful RAM capture; no continuous RAM hotplug verification.
ram_capture_old: Older confirmed RAM capture: refresh failed or was restricted. Occupancy has not been verified again.
ram_capture_unavailable: No confirmed RAM slot capture available.
ram_capture_superseded: Superseded: a new confirmed RAM capture shows a different module or an empty slot.
ram_mode_fallback: Unprivileged fallback after failed elevated capture
ram_refresh_failed: RAM refresh failed or was restricted. Existing confirmed module data retains its original timestamp and does not confirm current occupancy.
ram_fw_ok: Firmware values captured; not a live clock measurement
ram_fw_denied: Elevated dmidecode query denied or cancelled
ram_fw_conflict: Conflicting slot association or firmware values
ram_fw_unmatched: No unique firmware association for this slot
ram_fw_old: Older confirmed firmware values; refresh restricted or failed
ram_fw_smbios_warning: dmidecode reports limited support for this SMBIOS version; firmware values carry this caveat
ram_firmware_refresh_failed: RAM modules were captured but dmidecode speed information is not fully available. Previously confirmed values for the same module retain their original capture time. Check source status in device details and report.
admin_probe_ok: Combined helper completed; check individual source statuses
admin_probe_unsafe: Unsafe interpreter/helper path; elevated query not started
admin_probe_denied: Administrator query denied or cancelled; no second request
admin_source_missing: Tool missing or not safe to execute
